title: Pure persistence attribution with a q1-independent secret entity
question: Does retaining a q1-independent q2 entity across the action boundary improve q2 when its secret is masked from the post-boundary observation?
hypothesis: Carry will outperform fresh post-boundary reconstruction because only carry retains the q1-time secret state needed by q2.
held_constant: same multimodal encoders, residual-linear state write, optimizer, learning rate, weight decay, 300 steps, batch size 96, five seeds
fixed XOR execution; no operator discovery is tested
explicit entity addressing is retained; learned semantic addressing is not tested
no post-run model, checkpoint, seed, hyperparameter, or metric selection
integrity_gates: q1 and q2 target different explicit entity slots
q1 outcome depends only on q1-entity bits 0 and 1
q1 secret-interference test is exactly zero
post-boundary q2 observation is identical between arms and masks the secret
carry writes the post observation only to a scratch slot
fresh initializes q2 state only from the masked post observation
evaluation secret/visible combinations are exactly balanced

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass; carry-minus-fresh q2 >= 0.10; hierarchical paired bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that retaining q1-time q2 state provides a load-bearing persistence benefit on the registered synthetic task
decision_rule.does_not_license: general long-horizon memory, semantic memory, learned addressing, operator discovery, scaling, or real-world multimodal competence

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass but the criterion fails
decision_rule.licenses: the registered task does not demonstrate a load-bearing persistence benefit
decision_rule.does_not_license: memory impossibility or general PLM failure

decision_rule.condition: any information-flow, secret-interference, leakage, or artifact gate fails

arms.name: carry
arms.intervention: retain q2 entity state through q1 action/outcome and route the masked post-boundary observation to a scratch slot

arms.name: fresh_post_boundary
arms.intervention: discard all state and initialize q2 entity only from the masked post-boundary observation

interpretation_order: secret masking and q1 secret-interference gate
same q2 query and post-boundary observation
paired q2 difference and hierarchical uncertainty interval
